creator: Welcome.

Before you take your first step…
there is something you should
understand.

This world is larger than any one
region.

Its people travel.
Its POKéMON wander.
Its legends endure.

And sometimes…
things appear where they should
not.

Every journey begins somewhere.
Yours begins in Hoenn.

But where it ends…
that will be another matter
entirely.

I have only one request.
Explore.

Question what you see.
And when something feels out of
place… remember it.

Now then…
someone is waiting for you.
welcome:
Hey there!
Welcome to the world of POKéMON!

My name is Birch.
Professor Birch.

I study POKéMON in their natural
habitats…

which means I spend considerably
less time in my lab than my
assistants would prefer.
main:
People live alongside them in all
sorts of ways.

Some keep them as companions.
Some raise them for battle.

And some spend their whole lives
trying to understand them.

Lately, that last part has become
a little more complicated.

But…
we’ll get to that another time.
name:
Got it.
And your name?
recognition:
Nothing you need to worry about.
Not today, anyway.

Besides… I imagine we’ll have
plenty of time to talk once we
meet properly.

Your home is in Littleroot Town.
Quiet place. Small. Good people.

Though lately… Hoenn hasn’t been
quite as quiet as it used to be.

Get some rest, {PLAYER}.
Tomorrow might be more interesting
than you expect.
